studies.title: Maternal Sirolimus Therapy for Fetal Extensive Lymphatic Cystic Malformation: Selection Criteria, Management, and Outcomes in a Series of Six Cases
studies.finding: Maternal rapamycin (sirolimus) therapy for extensive fetal lymphatic malformations. Prenatal mTOR inhibition feasible with partial/marked lesion regression in 5/6 newborns; transplacental transfer observed. Observational case series (n=6); confounding by indication not excluded.

failed_note: GUIB2026 (first author): PubMed gives only the initial L, affiliations Lyon-Bron and Necker Institute Paris; no full given name.
